title: Scientific Notation

copy.studentInstructions: Convert between scientific notation and standard form. Use the direction shown with each call, then mark the matching answer in that column. Scientific notation uses a coefficient from 1 up to, but not including, 10.
copy.roomIntro: Practice conversions with large numbers and small decimals. M and T: scientific notation to standard form. A, H, and O: standard form to scientific notation. Choose the winning pattern below.
copy.roomHeading: Small decimals. Big numbers. Clear thinking.
copy.callerHeading: Big or small, find its form.
copy.callerSubtitle: Convert the number. Match the letter. Find your square.
copy.joinIntro: Get your teacher’s code. Let’s convert!
copy.footer: Move the decimal. Find your square.
copy.bankIntro: 50 conversions using positive numbers, including large values and small decimals. M: scientific notation to large standard-form numbers. A: large standard-form numbers to scientific notation. T: scientific notation to small decimals. H: small decimals to scientific notation. O: harder conversions to scientific notation, mixing large and small values with zeros inside the coefficient. Scientific notation always uses 1 ≤ coefficient < 10. Changes save in this browser; start a new game to edit questions already called.
